name: Dornier 228
summary: German high-wing twin turboprop with a long pointed nose, a boxy cabin and a distinctive advanced-technology wing, used as a commuter, utility and special-mission aircraft.

wings: High, straight wing with no struts
engines: Two Garrett TPE331 turboprops on the wing leading edge
fuselage: Boxy, slab-sided cabin with a flat belly
Blister sponsons on the lower fuselage sides
tail: Tailplane mounted on the rear fuselage

tellTales: Long pointed beak-like nose on a boxy high-wing twin
Single tall fin on a boxy, flat-sided fuselage

confusedWith.howToTell: The C-212 has a blunt, flat-faced nose and an upswept rear ramp; the Do 228 has a long pointed nose and no ramp.
The Shorts has wing struts and a blunt nose; the Do 228 has an unbraced wing and a long pointed nose.
The Twin Otter has a visible strut on each wing; the Do 228's wing is unbraced.
